messages:
inc-bot: ALERT SUPPRESSION detected: 6 pages suppressed by automation on alert-orch (trace=trc_9f3b). Reason: header_regex mismatch for source=vendor-x. No oncall pages were sent.
alex: wait — no pages at all? can someone confirm PD?
pagerduty-bot: No active page created (automation suppressed). Escalation policy: infra-oncall.
sam: copying the runbook: we should manual-page if oncall didn't get it. @monica are you on rotation?
monica: I am on-call now, I didn't get any PD page. seeing the console alert though. starting triage.
devon: past deploy touched alert-orch header parsing (PR #4212). suspect regex change. quick log snippet:
```
2026-02-22T14:03:12Z ERROR alert-orch parse_header: unmatched regex for header="X-Vendor-Payload: {..newField..}"
2026-02-22T14:03:13Z DEBUG suppressor: matched suppress-rule=automation-filter-v2?false
```
alex: ok manual fallback: I'm going to trigger a PD page and DM the rotation. sending now.
alex: (manual) created PD incident INC-5432: "alert-orch: paging automation suppressed; potential customer impact" linking traces.
pagerduty-bot: PD incident INC-5432 created and notified infra-oncall.
monica: received PD, thanks. what's the customer impact?
jess: telemetry: 14 alerts failed to route in last 10m, 3 customers with 5xx retries visible (cust-a, cust-b, cust-c). retry backlog ~1200 events.
monica: thanks. Devon, can you confirm whether the new header format caused the suppressor rule to treat these as non-actionable?
devon: yes. suppressor rule expects header match `^X-Vendor-Type: prod` but vendor-x started sending `X-Vendor-Payload` in last deploy. quick fix is to add alternate regex or revert parsing.
sam: can we hotfix regex in the suppressor? small change, deploy-safe. I can push in 10m.
alex: temp mitigation: re-enable legacy header fallback on prod suppressor. toggling flag now: `suppressor.use_legacy_header=true`
devon: flag toggled on canary, monitoring.
inc-bot: Canary toggle success on canary-1 (ok). No errors reported for 2m.
monica: confirmed manual pages being received and PD on-call acknowledged. please keep updates concise in this thread for the postmortem.
jess: customer comms draft ready, will post to #customers-comm in 5m after we confirm no further drop.
sam: hotfix patch pushed to staging: patch regex to accept either `X-Vendor-Type` or `X-Vendor-Payload` (see snippet).
devon: approving to prod. deploying hotfix now (rolling).
alex: deployment started, rollout id rlt-9988.
inc-bot: Deployment event: alert-orch v2.14.3 rolled to prod-canary at 1767775000; v2.14.4 hotfix started at 1767779999.
monica: monitoring -- if pages resume normally we can close manual fallback. status update in 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jess: comms sent to affected customers (cust-a,b,c) with mitigation note and ETA.
sam: prod checks green on first 3 canaries. suppressor now matching headers again.
monica: confirmed: suppressor no longer suppressing these alerts; PD pages resumed. marking live mitigation: done.
alex: created incident ticket INT-2026-063, brief: automation-filter regex regression due to header format change. next: RCA + owner + timeline.
monica: nice work. postmortem owners: devon (root cause), sam (automation test), jess (customer comms).
inc-bot: Incident INT-2026-063 created and linked to PD INC-5432.
monica: closing live thread. follow-up: schedule retro and add unit test for header variants. :white_check_mark:
